projects.title: Grade Automation Pro
projects.description: A professional-grade automated school grading system with robust cross-platform packaging.

details.subtitle: The Challenge
details.text: School environments often lack internet connectivity and have strict security protocols. The goal was to build a Python-based system that could be distributed as a standalone, secure executable.

details.subtitle: Technical Implementation
details.text: I utilized PyInstaller for binary compilation and Inno Setup for a professional Windows installer. This included embedding publisher metadata and automatically configuring Windows Firewall exceptions.

details.subtitle: Linux Adaptation
details.text: The entire workflow was adapted for Linux environments, resolving complex library dependencies and path redirects for cross-distro compatibility.

projects.title: TELE POS Integration
projects.description: Optimized Vue frontend with Vite-based standalone integrated with Frappe ERP systems, resulting in a lightning-fast POS interface.

details.subtitle: Vite Configuration Optimization
details.text: The project involved troubleshooting Vite asset redirects to enable a completely standalone frontend build that could run independent of a traditional web server.

details.subtitle: Frontend Architecture
details.text: Using Tailwind CSS for a utility-first design, I ensured the POS interface remains responsive and high-contrast for fast-paced retail environments.

projects.title: Odoo Drag-and-Drop Designer
projects.description: A specialized UI designer for ERP components that bridges the gap between visual design and XML/JSON schemas.

details.subtitle: Bridging XML and JSON
details.text: ERP systems like Odoo rely heavily on XML for view definitions. I architected a drag-and-drop system that allows designers to work in JSON-based UI components which are then accurately mapped to Odoo-compliant XML.

projects.title: Agricultural Operations Management
projects.description: Operational hub for managing field machinery, harvesting logistics, and logistics planning.

details.subtitle: Operational Clarity
details.text: Agricultural management requires tracking real-time data from the field. I designed this dashboard to provide clear visibility into machinery utilization and harvesting schedules.
